summary: 8 steps: 1 before the move (0 blocking), 1 to re-create, 1 for the move itself, 3 checks afterwards and 2 to roll back.

phases.title: Before the move: fix the blockers and make the decisions
phases.intro: Everything here is settled while the account is still at its current position. NO-GO steps block the move; REVIEW steps need a decision or a check by hand.

steps.title: Moving out of the registered OU Retail unenrolls the account from Control Tower
steps.detail: Control Tower governs accounts through their OU, and Sandbox (ou-fern-sand) is not registered with Control Tower. After the move the account is no longer enrolled: the 3 preventive guardrail SCP(s) of the old OU chain stop applying (see the SCP diff) and 4 detective control(s) stop reporting. The landing zone has auto-enrollment off: moved with Organizations, the account keeps the baseline resources, shows inheritance drift and stays that way until it is unenrolled properly. Unenroll it from Account Factory first if leaving governance is the intent; otherwise register the target OU and move the account with Control Tower's update-account flow. Decide which of the two it is and record it here; the rest of this runbook assumes the account is moved with Organizations and ends up unenrolled.
steps.where: management account 222222222221 of Fernhill Group (Account Factory)
steps.finding: Moving out of the registered OU Retail unenrolls the account from Control Tower
commands: # unenroll: Control Tower console → Account Factory → fernhill-retail-prod → Unmanage account
# or register the target OU: Control Tower console → Organization → the OU → Register OU, then move the account with the Update account flow

evidence.note: version 3.3, status ACTIVE, drift IN_SYNC; home region eu-west-1; governed regions eu-west-1, eu-central-1; auto-enrollment disabled
OU Retail registered: baseline 4.0, status SUCCEEDED, drift IN_SYNC
enrolled (source manual): status ENROLLED, drift unknown, parent OU unknown

phases.title: Before the move: re-create what does not travel
phases.intro: Shares, delegations, permission sets and stacks that are scoped to the account's current position do not follow it. Prepare the replacements now so nothing is interrupted.

steps.title: Replace what StackSet fernhill-baseline deploys into the account
steps.detail: Service-managed StackSets deploy by OU. Baseline IAM roles and GuardDuty membership. Check what those stacks provide (roles, Config recorders, GuardDuty membership) before moving. Decide: redeploy the template by hand in the account, add the account to a self-managed StackSet, or accept the loss.
steps.finding: StackSet fernhill-baseline stops targeting the account; stack instances are deleted from the account
commands: aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name fernhill-baseline --query StackSet.TemplateBody --output text

evidence.note: admin 222222222221; targets OUs ou-fern-bu accounts ; regions eu-west-1; auto-deployment true; retain on removal false

phases.title: The move
phases.intro: One Organizations call, or the Account Factory flow when Control Tower governs the account.

steps.title: Move the account through Account Factory to OU Sandbox (ou-fern-sand)
steps.detail: Control Tower expects the move to go through Account Factory so the baseline follows the account; moving it with Organizations directly leaves the landing zone in drift. Account Factory records the OU as a parameter of the provisioned product. Changing the OU through the product (Service Catalog, update provisioned product, or the Control Tower console) performs the move and re-applies the baseline; moving it in Organizations directly leaves the product behind, and the landing zone in drift unless auto-enrollment is on.
steps.where: management account 222222222221 of Fernhill Group (Account Factory)
steps.finding: Account was vended by Account Factory; move it by updating provisioned product fernhill-retail-prod
commands: # Control Tower console → Account Factory → fernhill-retail-prod → Update account → Organizational unit: OU Sandbox (ou-fern-sand)

aws servicecatalog update-provisioned-product --provisioned-product-name fernhill-retail-prod --product-name "AWS Control Tower Account Factory" --provisioning-artifact-name <current version> --provisioning-parameters Key=ManagedOrganizationalUnit,Value="Sandbox (ou-fern-sand)",UsePreviousValue=false Key=AccountName,UsePreviousValue=true Key=AccountEmail,UsePreviousValue=true Key=SSOUserEmail,UsePreviousValue=true Key=SSOUserFirstName,UsePreviousValue=true Key=SSOUserLastName,UsePreviousValue=true

phases.title: After the move: checks
phases.intro: Confirm what the simulation predicted and finish what could only be done once the account is at its new position.

steps.title: Confirm the account sits under OU Sandbox (ou-fern-sand) and the expected policies reach it
steps.detail: The parent must be ou-fern-sand. The policies listed for the account should match the target chain of the simulation (added: SCP Fernhill-Sandbox-Limits).

steps.title: Check for Config rules left behind by the detective controls that stopped applying
steps.detail: Enabled on the source OU chain and not on the target's. Detective controls stop applying to the account after the move. The Config rules they deployed are removed when the account is unenrolled or moved through Control Tower (or by auto-enrollment); moved by hand without it, they linger unmanaged.
steps.finding: 4 detective control(s) stop applying: AWS-GR_ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES, AWS-GR_RDS_STORAGE_ENCRYPTED, AWS-GR_RESTRICTED_COMMON_PORTS, AWS-GR_RESTRICTED_SSH

steps.title: Collect a fresh snapshot and simulate the account at its new position
steps.detail: With the account inside the target organization, a simulation of the account against its own parent compares it with itself and should come back GO, which closes the runbook.

phases.title: Rollback
phases.intro: If something breaks, this puts the account back where it was. Built from the source policy chain of the simulation.

steps.title: Move the account back to OU Retail (ou-fern-ret) through Account Factory
steps.detail: Update the account in Account Factory again, with the original OU, so the baseline follows it back.
steps.where: management account 222222222221 of Fernhill Group (Account Factory)
commands: # Control Tower console → Account Factory → fernhill-retail-prod → Update account → Organizational unit: OU Retail (ou-fern-ret)

steps.title: Verify the original policy chain reaches the account again
steps.detail: Compare with the source chain recorded by the simulation, root to account.
